sections.title: The Qatar Channel: Access to Sheikh Hamad bin Jassim
sections.content:

(EFTA02368670). Two weeks before the blockade began, on May 6, 2017, Epstein had invited Jabor and HBJ to discuss "trump middle east trip at the end of the month" (EFTA02388899), referring to Trump's May 20-21 visit to Riyadh and Jerusalem. Epstein was thus positioning himself as a briefer of Qatari royals on US policy in the weeks immediately preceding the crisis his advice later addressed.

Whether Jabor understood the implications of providing genetic material under another person's account, or whether the registration arrangement was presented as a mere administrative convenience, is not documented.

The DNA collection sits within a broader pattern of Epstein exercising tradecraft-adjacent practices with Jabor. Epstein maintained Jabor's full VCF contact card through at least March 2019 (EFTA02280199). He used Jabor's name and connections to secure landing permits, visas, and property access across multiple jurisdictions. Whether this arrangement carried FARA implications depends on whether Jabor was acting at the direction of the Qatari government or solely as a private family member, a distinction that the documentary record does not definitively resolve.
